# Aman Meena — Full Stack Developer & AI Systems Engineer

## Summary
Aman Meena is a Full Stack Developer & AI Systems Engineer based in New Delhi, India.
Specializes in production RAG systems, agentic AI workflows (LangGraph, LangChain), scalable web architecture (React, Next.js, FastAPI, TypeScript, Python), and distributed system design.

## Experience
- Accenture (Software Intern, Dec 2025 - May 2026): Analyzed 200+ ServiceNow ITSM tickets (~55% volume reduction triage). Earned P3 top-tier MyCompetency rating across Agentic AI, RAG, AWS, and Azure.
- DGFT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry (AI Intern, Jun 2025 - Jul 2025): Built and deployed enterprise RAG chatbot indexing 100+ policy documents (2K text chunks), achieving 75-85% retrieval@3 and boosting policy-aligned answer accuracy from 54% to 81%.
- DIPR, DRDO (Research Intern, Jul 2024 - Aug 2024): Designed multimodal deception-detection pipeline (DistilBERT + librosa + Random Forest late-fusion ensemble) achieving 81% accuracy on ~1K labeled samples.
